comment: Image manifest for the smalltalk80-2026 launchers. Fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avwohl/st80-images/main/manifest.json (see kManifestUrl in app/linux/Launcher.cpp and kManifestHost / kManifestPath in app/windows/Launcher.cpp). Each asset carries the SHA256 digest of the published release asset; the launcher verifies after download and deletes the file on mismatch.
